item.title: MenuDart 1.3.0
item.description:
MenuDart 1.3.0

  • New: an Apps popup lists your installed apps like Launchpad did. Arrange them in your own order, make folders, pin favorites, browse by category, and type to search. It can also open full screen.
  • Icons in the Apps and Menu Bar Icons popups glide into place on a spring.
  • Menu Bar Icons now shows apps that run only in the background, leaves out macOS's « / » button, and shows the selected icon's name when it opens.
  • The tutorial has a new Apps page.

item.title: MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.10
item.description:
MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.10 (beta)

  • Fixed: Menu Bar Icons now shows apps that run only in the background, such as LightsOut.
  • Fixed: macOS's « / » button no longer appears in Menu Bar Icons, and apps no longer show up twice.
  • Fixed: when Menu Bar Icons opens, the selected icon's name is shown right away.

item.title: MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.9
item.description:
MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.9 (beta)

  • Fixed: a dropped icon now settles from where you let it go instead of rushing in from far away.
  • Fixed: the Favorites row no longer leaves a wide empty space below its icons.

item.title: MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.8
item.description:
MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.8 (beta)

  • Icons now move on a spring when you rearrange them, the way macOS moves things.
  • A folder's row of apps unfolds when you open it and folds away when you close it.

item.title: MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.7
item.description:
MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.7 (beta)

  • A pinned folder in Favorites now opens its row of apps under Favorites, with the corner button to show it full size.

item.title: MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.6
item.description:
MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.6 (beta)

  • New: choose a category with the arrow keys in the category view.
  • New: a new folder opens with its name selected, ready to type.
  • Fixed: icons that scrolled past the pointer could stay highlighted.

item.title: MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.5
item.description:
MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.5 (beta)

  • New: a category view in the Apps view, from the toggle next to the search field.
  • New: Favorites. Click the 📌 on an app or folder to pin it to the top.
  • The Remove and Move buttons in a full-size folder have icons and no longer look cut off.

item.title: MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.4
item.description:
MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.4 (beta)

  • Fixed: MenuDart could quit when you closed a popup while a MenuDart window, such as Settings, was in front.

item.title: MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.3
item.description:
MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.3 (beta)

  • New: show the Apps view full screen like Launchpad. Choose it in Settings → Apps.
  • Fixed: Safari was missing from the Apps view on macOS 26.

item.title: MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.2
item.description:
MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.2 (beta)

  • New: the tutorial has a page for the Apps popup, with its shortcut, keys and how folders work. If you saw the tutorial before, MenuDart asks once whether to see the updated one.

item.title: MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.1
item.description:
MenuDart 1.3.0-beta.1 (beta)

  • New: an Apps popup lists your installed apps like Launchpad did, in your own order, with folders and search. Set its shortcut in Settings → Shortcuts.
  • Click a folder to open a row of its apps under it; its corner button shows the folder full size, where you can take several apps out at once or move apps in from anywhere.

item.title: MenuDart 1.2.5
item.description:
MenuDart 1.2.5

  • New: the ⌘Tab switcher can arrange its icons to match your screen's shape. Choose Icon Layout in Settings → Shortcuts.
  • New: MenuDart is now also in Indonesian, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Thai, Turkish and Vietnamese (18 languages).
  • Updated license agreement (1.1): one license is for one person, on up to 5 of their own Macs. You'll be asked to agree once after updating.

item.title: MenuDart 1.2.4
item.description:
MenuDart 1.2.4

  • Fixed: in Menu Bar Icons, an icon that opens a window instead of a menu could open it behind other windows, or say nothing happened, on some Macs. MenuDart now brings the app and its window to the front.

item.title: MenuDart 1.2.3
item.description:
MenuDart 1.2.3

  • ⌘Tab switcher: the Settings hint and the tutorial now explain that the selected app's name appears under its icon, and that you switch by letting go of ⌘, pressing Return, or clicking an icon. All 11 languages.

item.title: MenuDart 1.2.2
item.description:
MenuDart 1.2.2

  • ⌘Tab switcher: the selected app's name now appears in a small bubble under its icon, as in the Menu Bar Icons popup. Let go of ⌘, press Return, or click an icon to switch.

item.title: MenuDart 1.2.1
item.description:
MenuDart 1.2.1

  • Fixed: in the ⌘Tab switcher, choosing an app did nothing on some Macs. MenuDart now switches the way the Dock does and raises the app's window; an app with no open window gets a new one. Let go of ⌘, press Return, or click an icon to switch.
  • Menu Bar Icons: moving to an icon with the arrow keys shows its name, the way pointing at it does, when icon names are hidden or cut short.

item.title: MenuDart 1.2.1-beta.1
item.description:
MenuDart 1.2.1 beta 1

  • Beta: in Menu Bar Icons, moving to an icon with the arrow keys now shows its name, the way pointing at it does, when icon names are hidden or the name was cut short.

item.title: MenuDart 1.2.0
item.description:
MenuDart 1.2.0

  • New ⌘Tab app switcher (off by default; turn it on in Settings › Shortcuts) shows open apps in several rows on a glass panel. Hold ⌘ and use Tab or the arrow keys to move, then let go to switch.
  • A tutorial covers every feature with its keys and options. Open it any time from Settings › General › Tutorial.
  • Menu Bar Icons: Coco the cat looks through the menus while the list refreshes.
  • Fixed: with scroll bars set to always show, the first item of a submenu was cut off under the header.

item.title: MenuDart 1.2.0-beta.1
item.description:
MenuDart 1.2.0 beta 1

  • Beta: a ⌘Tab app switcher (off by default; turn it on in Settings › Shortcuts) shows open apps in several rows on a glass panel. Hold ⌘ and use Tab or the arrow keys to move, then let go to switch.
  • A tutorial covers every feature with its keys and options. Open it any time from Settings › General › Tutorial.
  • Menu Bar Icons: Coco the cat looks through the menus while the list refreshes.
  • Fixed: with scroll bars set to always show, the first item of a submenu was cut off under the header.

item.title: MenuDart 1.1.0
item.description:
MenuDart 1.1.0

  • App Menus: a new Outline layout shows every menu as one tree. Type to search every menu item, submenus included, with its menu path.
  • New Theme setting: Classic looks like macOS menus; Smoke is smoked glass with a Transparency slider, and also applies to Settings.
  • Menu Bar Icons: icon names can be turned off to show the icons alone, like the Dock.

item.title: MenuDart 1.0.8
item.description:
MenuDart 1.0.8

  • Menu Bar Icons: type as soon as the popup opens to find an icon by name or app. The first match is selected, so Space or Return opens it. Input methods work as usual, and Korean initial consonants match too.

item.title: MenuDart 1.0.7
item.description:
MenuDart 1.0.7

  • App Menus: the first command of an opened menu is no longer half hidden under the title bar.
  • App Menus: a newly opened menu starts on its top item instead of the item under the pointer, and the first level starts on the app's own first menu rather than the Apple menu.
  • Menu Bar Icons: "Icons per row" is now a 3–15 slider that warns when the popup would be too wide for your smallest display.
  • Menu Bar Icons: the popup can no longer be shrunk until icons become too small to read.

item.title: MenuDart 1.0.6
item.description:
MenuDart 1.0.6

  • The Menu Bar Icons popup lists icons in the same order every time: built-in macOS icons first by name, then other apps' icons by app name.
  • New option in Settings → Menu Bar Icons: Show Built-in macOS Icons.
  • Improved stability.

item.title: MenuDart 1.0.5
item.description:
MenuDart 1.0.5

  • New Speed and Size sliders for the pointer effect in Settings → Menu Bar Icons. Make the flight faster or slower, and the rocket, trail, dart or Ddoee bigger or smaller.
  • Buy buttons now tell the checkout page which button you used. It's a plain label with no identifier.

item.title: MenuDart 1.0.4
item.description:
MenuDart 1.0.4

  • The Menu Bar Icons popup opens instantly. MenuDart keeps the icon list ready in the background and refreshes it while the popup is open.
  • New options: refresh the icon list on a timer, and hide the Dock icon when Settings closes.

item.title: MenuDart 1.0.3
item.description:
MenuDart 1.0.3

  • New option in Settings → Updates: Get beta updates. Turn it on to try new features before they're released.
  • Settings → About now links to the new Privacy Policy. MenuDart doesn't track you.

item.title: MenuDart 1.0.2
item.description:
MenuDart 1.0.2

  • New pointer effect: Ddoee, a caped cat that flies your pointer to the menu. Choose it in Settings → Menu Bar Icons → Effect.

item.title: MenuDart 1.0.1
item.description:
MenuDart 1.0.1

  • Before you buy, MenuDart lets you know about a running sale and when it ends, at most once a day. You can turn it off for that sale.
  • During a sale, Buy buttons open checkout with the discount code already filled in.

item.title: MenuDart 1.0.0
item.description:
MenuDart 1.0.0

First release.

  • App Menus popup: the frontmost app's menus next to the pointer, even when they don't fit in the menu bar.
  • Menu Bar Icons popup: every menu bar icon in a grid, including ones hidden by a crowded menu bar or the notch.
  • Available in 11 languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Hindi, Italian, German and French.
  • 14-day free trial, then a one-time license.
